note: Reference values for scale, not measurements. Food energy uses 1 kcal = 4.184 kJ = 1.1622 Wh. duration_seconds marks items measured in time, used to express counts below 1 as a duration.

items.basis: 1000 W microwave running for 1 minute (1000 W x 60 s)
1500 W hair dryer running for 1 minute (1500 W x 60 s)
Heating 1 L of water from 20 C to 100 C: 4.18 kJ/(kg K) x 1 kg x 80 K = 334 kJ, with no heat loss, so a lower bound
Laptop drawing 50 W for 1 hour (assumed typical load)
